title: Measuring and Addressing Indexical Bias in Information Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the positional order and visibility of documents in search engine rankings using the unsupervised DUO (Discounted Uniformity of Perspectives) metric, which uses logarithmic rank decay to measure how skewed rankings manipulate user attention and opinions.

Measuring the balance and variance of opposing perspectives on controversial topics by projecting document embeddings onto a polarized semantic axis using PCA, and analyzing whether retrieved results disproportionately favor one side of an issue.
